import numpy as np

def attention_forward(Q, K, V):
    d = Q.shape[1]
    scale = 1.0 / np.sqrt(d)

    S = (Q @ K.T) * scale
    S_max = np.max(S, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    exp_S = np.exp(S - S_max)
    P = exp_S / np.sum(exp_S, axis=1, keepdims=True)

    out = P @ V
    cache = (Q, K, V, P, scale)
    return out, cache

def attention_backward(dout, cache):
    Q, K, V, P, scale = cache

    dV = P.T @ dout
    dP = dout @ V.T

    row_sum = np.sum(dP * P, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    dS = P * (dP - row_sum)

    dQ = (dS @ K) * scale
    dK = (dS.T @ Q) * scale

    return dQ, dK, dV
